overview_description.description:
Accolade is a health, wellness, and fitness company that features personalized health and benefits solutions that help to improve the experience, outcomes, and cost of healthcare for employers. It specializes in healthcare process improvement, healthcare savings, employee engagement, and personalized advocacy.

The company was founded in 2007 and headquartered in Plymouth Meeting, Pennsylvania.

about_short_description.short_description: Accolade features personalized health and benefits solutions that help to improve experience, outcomes, and healthcare cost for employers.

product.name: Accolade Care
product.description: A virtual primary and mental health care service providing appointments with board-certified physicians and licensed therapists for preventive, urgent, chronic, and behavioral health needs.

product.name: Accolade Advocacy and Care Navigation
product.description: A personalized healthcare navigation service that helps members understand benefits, locate in-network providers, coordinate appointments, resolve claims questions, and make care decisions.

product.name: 2nd.MD by Accolade
product.description: An expert medical opinion service that connects members with leading specialists for virtual second opinions on diagnoses, treatment plans, medications, and complex medical conditions.

product.name: Accolade Case Management Program
product.description: A nurse-led service that helps members with complex or chronic conditions create care plans, coordinate providers, understand treatment options, and manage healthcare needs.

product.name: Accolade Health Plan Solutions
product.description: A configurable suite of healthcare capabilities for health plans, including advocacy, virtual primary care, expert medical opinions, provider search, analytics, predictive engagement, and white-labeled member experiences.
